conversationalSummary.text: Today is probably not worth chasing—there’s no reliable window. Cantinho da Baia is the best available option, but the wind angle looks poor and that’s the main thing that could ruin it, even with a bit of tide help in the sheltered bay. I’d check Surfline or MEO Beachcam before leaving (especially for wind), and if it doesn’t look noticeably better, I’d save the drive.

best.explanation: Cantinho da Baia looks like a fun-sized window for Safe fun, Medium confidence: 0.6-1.1 m, 309 kJ, 10 s period, workable consistency 64/100, and wind is the main risk.  A forgiving sandy bay with lots of take-off points; this is best for easy wave count and cleaner faces when the north wind is bothering exposed beaches; 10-13s at mid tide gives the sheltered bay workable wrap-around lines.  Watch: wind angle is poor for this spot; SwellMap rating 3/10 Poor — caution.
best.shortExplanation: Cantinho da Baia is worth a quick check for after work (18:00 start), but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  Wind is the main thing to watch.  The tide should help the bay stay organised.
